manifest.name: Writing tools
manifest.description: Count words or remove trailing spaces from the captured source. Changes are reviewed before applying.

code: manuslipPlugin.register(({ commandId, document }) => { if (!document) throw new Error('Document read access is required'); if (commandId === 'word-count') return String(document.text.trim().split(/\s+/u).filter(Boolean).length) + ' source words'; if (commandId === 'trim-lines') return document.text.replace(/[ \t]+$/gm, ''); throw new Error('Unknown command'); });
